role: Separate numerical sensitivity test chosen after completion of the primary density comparison. It does not alter the primary contract.
fixed: C0/C1 records, all collective modes and unobserved scalar outputs included, same future collar, same absolute history coefficients and initial density center 1/8.
narrow: One normalized uniform clock lobe centered on affine T3, half-width 1/32.
split: Original equal-phase two-lobe packet, centers offset by +/-1/16, same lobe half-width 1/32. The clock mean is unchanged; its variance increases by 1/256.
observable: Signed score, +1 for one comparable pair, -1 for three, 0 for failure. Report all three unconditional probabilities. No conditioning or efficiency renormalization.
null: Identical dust/clock transfer on both branches gives zero mean score for either preparation.
resolution: Exact control, numerical coupled contrast, same three grids; no interval certificate or physical gate promotion.
